core_obligations: Reformulate: the limit is the intersection, inside the product, of the closed subsets determined by the graphs of the transition maps (proof lines 2731-2740)
Reduce to finite intersections: by the finite intersection criterion it suffices to show that any finite family of those subsets has nonempty intersection (proof lines 2740-2743)

Build a compatible family: cofilteredness produces an object mapping to all the objects involved and equalizing the finitely many competing morphisms, so a point of that object, transported along the transitions and supplemented by arbitrary choices elsewhere, lies in all the chosen subsets (proof lines 2744-2762)
proof_roadmap: 由 inverse-limit-quasi-compact 的证明，X = lim X_i 是积空间中闭子集 Z_φ = Γ_φ × ∏ X_l 的交。
由「准紧空间中闭集族若有限交非空则全交非空」判据，只需证任意有限个 Z_φ 之交非空。
取有限个 φ_t: j_t → k_t；由 I 余滤，取 j 与 ψ_t: j → j_t，再取 j' → j 使所有需相等的复合相等；取 x ∈ X_{j'} 沿转移推得各 x_{j_t}, x_{k_t}，其余指标任取（用选择公理），所得点落在所有 Z_{φ_t} 中。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an inverse limit of nonempty quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces over a cofiltered category is nonempty (author lemma at source lines 2723-2729, label lemma-nonempty-limit). The proof (source lines 2731-2763) writes the limit as an intersection of closed subsets of the product cut out by the graphs of the transition maps, reduces by the finite intersection criterion to finitely many such subsets and constructs a compatible family using cofilteredness and equalization (proof lines 2731-2762). The finite intersection reduction and the construction of the compatible family are the substance. H3.
